cohort: Pregnant women whose medical records were analyzed from multiple institutions (156 records in Phase 1, 104 in Phase 2).
finding: No direct relationship was found between periodontitis and neonatal weight in COVID-19-positive cases, and dental care did not influence maternal-fetal outcomes.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from medical records between 2020 and 2021.
birth_weight: Mean neonatal weight ranged from 2271g (no dental care) to 2336g (dental care).
